_comment: Intentional deltas between board_b_spec.py and the netlist-derived baseline (board-b.json). Every entry is a locked wave-6 decision or a derived-not-baselined net; sources per delta are in _sources. check_baseline.py reads only added_nets/removed_nets/added_pins/removed_pins.

_sources.+12V rail / +5V rail / -12V rail: baseline unresolved rows 1-3; PTC second pins + TVS rail legs + Faston tabs + J10/J11 pin pairs derived from spec-architecture-review.md Board B section, board-b-synth-power.md Output Connectors tables (J6=-12V, J7=+12V, J8=+5V, J9=GND both tabs), and the component-hdr-2541wr-2x08p-c5383092 pin map (pin-pair rail map: 1-2 GATE, 3-4 CV, 5-6 +5V, 7-8 +12V, 9-14 GND, 15-16 -12V). TVS1/TVS2 cathode-to-rail, anode-to-GND per SMAJ15A/SMAJ6.5A symbol pin maps; TVS3 cathode-to-GND anode-to--12V per decisions.json dec-tvs3-orientation-lock (BB-9).
_sources.GATE rail / CV rail: baseline unresolved rows 4-5; isolated J10/J11 stubs per board-b-synth-power.md J10/J11 table and the header bundle pin map.
_sources.GND added pins (J9/J10/J11): baseline unresolved row 6; J9 both tabs per the Faston table, J10/J11 pins 9-14 GND moat per the header bundle pin map.
_sources.GND added pins (D1.2, D2.2): review finding BB-11: buck catch-diode anode ground returns, omitted from the doc net tables and the baseline's own unresolved list.
_sources.GND added pins (C3.2, C4.2, C11.1, R5.2,: baseline unresolved row 7 (doc-implied DC-DC GND pins: output-cap far plates, U4 bottom FB resistor, C33 feedforward mirror).
_sources.C12 pins (-13.5V OUT: C12.2, GND: C12.1): decisions.json neg-rail-cap-bank: third can added to the -13.5V output bank so no output electrolytic exceeds 85% of its 150kHz-derated ripple rating at the 0.8 A rated load. C12 is not in the netlist-derived baseline because it did not exist at v0.4.0. Pin sense mirrors C24 (pin 2 on the rail, pin 1 on GND).
_sources.GND added pins (LED2.2, LED3.1, LED4.2): review finding BB-13: LED indicator wiring absent from the baseline; polarity per the component-project-passives pin maps (KT-0603YG green pin1=A/pin2=K reversed numbering; KT-0603B and KT-0603R pin1=K/pin2=A). LED4 anode on GND so the red indicator conducts into the negative rail.
_sources.J5 pins (+15V gen: J5.1/J5.2, GND: J5.5/: locked A-B interface contract (board-split-decision.md #90 decision set (b), mirrored in board-b-synth-power.md): pins 1-2 +15V, 3 ATT, 4 PDOK, 5-6 GND. ATT/PDOK are open-drain with no on-board pull-up.
decisions.json dec-p1-att-pdok-provision: PogoPad_1x04 bare pads, pin 4 declared NO_CONNECT.
_sources.TP3.1 / TP4.1 / TP5.1: bare-copper rail test pads carried from the legacy dc-dc-conversion sheet (TP3 +13.5V, TP4 +7.5V, TP5 -13.5V); pre-declared as board-b exclusions in the component-spec-audit inventory.
